description_for_human: Sub-microsecond cryptographic M2M micro-payment and compute clearing layer on Base L2.
description_for_model: Causal-Slash Protocol (CSLS) enables autonomous AI agents to purchase remote frontier compute, inference (Claude Opus 5.5, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Gemini 4 Argon), vector embeddings, and web intelligence without Web2 API keys or KYC. Settlement occurs via 167-byte Session MAC micro-cheques authenticated by secp256k1 keys and backed by Base L2 collateral vaults (PerformanceCollateralVault.sol, SwarmDelegationVault.sol). Bilateral and multilateral obligations cancel in RAM via Tarjan SCC Kirchhoff debt netting with zero gas.

auth.instructions: All paid endpoints require a 167-byte cryptographic Session MAC micro-cheque transmitted in the X-Causal-Cheque HTTP header. Zero Web2 API keys required.
